footer.tagline: Our family home on the edge of Maria Alm — for friends, and friends of friends.

home.heroSubtitle: Our family home on the edge of Maria Alm, overlooking the Hochkönig mountains. Sleeps 6 to 8, summer and winter alike.
home.highlightGuestsText: Three bedrooms, a spacious living room and a sunny garden — plenty of room for the whole group.
home.highlightSkiText: 150 km of slopes on your doorstep: the ski lift is a 5-minute drive and the ski bus stops 300 metres away.
home.highlightVillageText: Shops and restaurants a 10-minute walk away, in one of the prettiest villages of Salzburgerland.
home.introText: Sonnenwiese isn't a rental business — it's our own holiday home, which we love sharing with friends and friends of friends. You'll find everything you have at home, with the mountains as your back garden. In winter you're on the slopes within minutes; in summer you walk straight out into the meadows and mountain trails.
home.winterText: The ski bus stops three hundred metres from the door and the nearest lift is a five-minute drive. Beyond it lies the Hochkönig region: a hundred and fifty kilometres of piste, from gentle blues to serious runs. There is cross-country skiing, tobogganing and winter walking too.
home.summerTitle: Straight from the door into the meadows
home.summerText: A loop through the flower meadows before breakfast, or a full day out in the massif — no need to get in the car first. And if you would rather skip the climb, the cable car takes you up.
home.closingText: See when the house is free and send a request. You will get a personal reply — usually within a few days.

apartment.title: The apartment
apartment.intro: Newly built and furnished in 2004, the apartment comfortably sleeps 6 to 8 people. Everything is here: a modern kitchen, three bedrooms, a sunny garden and a wonderful view of the Hochkönig mountainside.
apartment.livingText: A cosy living room with a large sofa — the place to gather after a day of skiing or hiking. Satellite TV with Dutch channels and internet are available.
apartment.kitchenText: The modern kitchen is fully equipped, with a combi oven and dishwasher. Big enough to cook for the whole group.
apartment.bedroomsText: Two bedrooms with a double bed and a third bedroom with a bunk bed and a single bed. Everyone — from 6 to 8 guests — sleeps comfortably.
apartment.bathroomText: A full bathroom and a separate toilet, so mornings never get crowded.
apartment.gardenText: The garden catches the sun and comes with garden furniture — perfect for long summer evenings or a coffee with a mountain view.

amenities.bedrooms: 3 bedrooms (2x double bed, 1x bunk bed + single bed)
amenities.kitchen: Modern kitchen with combi oven and dishwasher

surroundings.title: The surroundings
surroundings.intro: Sonnenwiese sits on the edge of Maria Alm, one of the prettiest villages of Salzburgerland — worth visiting all year round.
surroundings.villageText: An authentic Austrian mountain village with a charming centre: shops, restaurants and cafés a 10-minute walk from the apartment. The famous church with its tall spire is the heart of the village.
surroundings.winterText: Maria Alm is part of the Hochkönig ski area, part of Ski Amadé: 150 kilometres of slopes for all levels. The nearest ski lift is a 5-minute drive and the ski bus stops 300 metres from the house. Cross-country skiing, tobogganing and winter hiking are also plentiful.
surroundings.summerText: In summer Maria Alm is a paradise for hikers and cyclists. From gentle walks through the meadows to serious mountain hikes in the Hochkönig massif — you step straight from the house into nature. In summer, cable cars take you up without the climb, too.

pricing.title: Prices
pricing.intro: Rental is per week: from Saturday 3 pm to Saturday 10 am (Sunday–Sunday is sometimes possible by arrangement). These are the prices for 2024/2025.

included.internet: Internet and satellite TV (with Dutch channels)

extras.tax: Tourist tax — € 1.10 p.p. per night (14 and over), € 0.40 for children under 14
extras.linen: Bed linen and towels — please bring your own

payment.deposit: After confirmation you pay a deposit within 14 days; the remainder no later than 6 weeks before arrival.
payment.cancel: If you cancel more than 6 weeks before arrival, 50% of the rent is due; at 4 weeks or less, the full rent. Cancellation insurance can be arranged through us (3.5% of the total).
payment.pets: Pets are welcome — please let us know in advance.

practical.title: Directions & practical
practical.intro: Everything you need to know for your stay: how to get here, how arrival and departure work, and our house rules.
practical.routeText: The apartment is at Klinglerau 5 (apartment Top 1, ground floor), 5760 Saalfelden — officially just inside Saalfelden, but practically on the edge of Maria Alm; we always say Maria Alm ourselves. From the Netherlands it's about a 10-hour drive: via Munich and Salzburg towards Bischofshofen, then via the B164 to Maria Alm.
practical.arrivalText: Rental is per week, Saturday to Saturday: arrival from 3 pm, departure by 10 am. We'll arrange the key handover with you personally.
practical.rulesText: It is and remains our family home — a few agreements keep it enjoyable for everyone:
practical.questionsText: Send a request via the availability page or ask your question in the message field — we're happy to help.

rules.smoking: Smoking is not allowed in the apartment
rules.pets: Pets are welcome — please let us know in advance
rules.ski: Please keep skis and ski boots in the ski room in the basement
rules.trash: You dispose of household waste (including glass and paper) yourself
rules.kitchen: Please leave the kitchen — including oven and dishwasher — clean

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Sonnenwiese isn't a company, it's a family home — and that's how we treat your details too: we only ask for what we need to answer your request, and then we throw it away.
privacy.controllerText: Frits de Leeuw looks after Sonnenwiese and is responsible for the details that come in through this site. Questions about them? Write to <mail>mail@sonnenwiese.nl</mail> — it goes straight to him.
privacy.dataIntro: If you send a request through the form, we store:

data.name: your name
data.phone: your phone number, if you fill it in — it isn't required
data.dates: your arrival and departure dates and how many of you are coming
data.message: your message, if you leave one
data.locale: the language you were reading the site in, so we reply in that language

privacy.dataFooter: Nothing more. No home address, no date of birth, no payment details — we sort that out personally if your stay goes ahead.
privacy.whyText: To check whether the apartment is free, answer your request and arrange your stay. That is the only reason. You won't get a newsletter from us, we don't sell anything on, and your details never go to anyone else for their own purposes.
privacy.retentionText: One year after your request. The site then deletes it automatically — every night, with no one involved. If your stay falls further ahead, we wait until it is over; otherwise the calendar would show those days as free again. If you'd like it gone sooner, a short email is enough. One exception: if your request turns into an actual stay, the invoice ends up in the owner's bookkeeping. He is legally required to keep that for seven years, separately from this website.
privacy.sharedIntro: Only the services that keep the site running. They may use your details for that purpose alone:

shared.supabase: Supabase — the database your request is stored in, on servers in Frankfurt, Germany
shared.resend: Resend — sends the confirmation to you and the notification to us, from servers in Europe
shared.cloudflare: Cloudflare — looks after the domain and forwards post sent to mail@sonnenwiese.nl

privacy.cookiesText: We don't have any. No analytics, no advertising, no social media buttons looking over your shoulder. That's why you won't see a cookie notice here — there is simply nothing to accept. The map on the practical page comes from OpenStreetMap and doesn't set any either.
privacy.rightsText: You can always ask what we hold about you, have it corrected, or have it erased. One message to <mail>mail@sonnenwiese.nl</mail> is enough. If we can't work it out together, you can complain to the Dutch data protection authority or to the regulator in your own country.
privacy.securityText: The site runs entirely over an encrypted connection, and the database can't be reached directly from the internet — only the site itself can get to it.
